source: Author requested hide, fur, delicate chainmail, insulated and chitin clothing families as separate individual garments, October 15, 2026. Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md controls no-cloth/no-wood and low-yield hide/fur rules. Existing electrical clothing IDs reused; generic suit refined to one jacket.
scope: 25 separate clothing pieces across five families: 22 new entries and three reused electrical-wear IDs. No counted full-set item, set bonus, runtime equipment, world identity, streaming or saved gameplay changes.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Booter-worn garment concept; fit, packing and canister clearance unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed garment craft or trade; availability and price unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate construction from qualified stock and compatible joining parts. No full-set recipe, quantities, yield or crafting time assigned.
defaults.Limitations: Fit, comfort, flexibility, mass, wear and protective performance require design. No wood, ordinary cloth, conventional abundant hide/fur supply, free-water treatment, set bonus or new equipment slots.
defaults.Classification basis: Independently listed clothing piece. Family membership is an organizational grouping, not another counted inventory item or a set bonus.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed finished-garment planning tier; recipe and performance unresolved.

items.name: Hide jacket
items.purpose: Hide clothing family: one separately listed jacket. One upper-body garment; no trousers, gloves, footwear or headwear included. Small fitted hide panels, overlapped seams and simple metal closures. Usable hide yields are extremely low. Functions and performance remain proposals.
items.icon: Hide jacket. Small fitted hide panels, overlapped seams and simple metal closures. Usable hide yields are extremely low. Show only this garment or matched pair; no full outfit or wearer.
